verdict.rationale: 2FAS gives users strong control over where data is stored (self-host, local file, iCloud/Google Drive) and emphasizes no permanent third-party storage of items, which implicitly supports retention control, but there is no explicit documentation of an account/data deletion mechanism or retention policy, and a community post questions how 'local-only' claims hold up given cloud backup options. Missing for 10: explicit deletion/account-removal controls, documented retention policy, and independent verification of deletion behavior.
